title: mail: Email/set update for keywords (\Seen, \Flagged)
description:
Wire Email/set update keyword patches to UserFlagsStore: accept {keywords: {\Seen: true}} style patches, call set_flags for each requested id, return updated Email objects (or setErrors for not-found CIDs). Merge stored flags into keywords map in Email/get and Email/query results.

Why: \Seen is how clients track read state; without this, every message appears unread on every sync.

Acceptance: Email/set update with \Seen=true, then Email/get for same id returns keywords: {\Seen: true}.
